additional_info.subject: 0434636 - ID0434636-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/S3 300000004080] Outlet 2: outoforder, MeterState: Working CRM:00314000189
additional_info.body:
Dear Emre,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0434636
. The ticket is opened for random unavailability of outlet DC2.
I monitored the charger in the past two days, but I was never able to catch the error flag "Outlet 2: outoforder", but in the logs I saw several times the charger setting DC2 outoforder in correspondence with "SECC: no communication for 750ms".
It looks to me as a communication issue with the Main EcoG KF11. Since the charger is already with the Hotfix EcoG v1.4.12, which has hardening patches for communication, I believe the issue could be in the Ethernet cable of the EcoG KF11, or in the KF11 itself.
Therefore, I would proceed to go onsite and replace both Ethernet cable and EcoG KF11.
Please let us know if you need further support for the troubleshooting.
Looking forward to hearing from you soon!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
